title: trachoma minuta
intro: Trachoma minuta, commonly known as Wild Chamomile, is a flowering plant belonging to the Asteraceae family. The plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of Trachoma minuta include soothing digestive issues, relieving anxiety, and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
